metadata.name: Test Generation
metadata.description: Adds or updates executable test code for one authorized target in an existing project. Captures repository, target behavior, test levels and VCS authority; materializes a durable workspace; analyzes production behavior and existing project test patterns; designs behavior/risk/boundary cases; writes the complete authorized test, fixture, configuration and coverage-record change to real project paths; performs a fresh producer completion pass before targeted and broader deterministic commands; and requires independent semantic review. Test, target/design and evidence defects have cause-owned repair; production-code requirements end in a durable Software Development Flow handoff. Autonomous mode skips human waits only, and VCS effects require separate originating authority. The workflow never modifies production code, publishes, notifies, releases or deploys. Choose Test Planning for strategy without code, Test Suite Audit for an existing-suite audit, or Software Development Flow for production implementation with tests and documentation.

nodes.directive: Reuse the originating test-generation request and explicit repository, target behavior, scope, operating mode, acceptance, test/config/fixture authority and separate commit/push decisions. Read only non-mutating context needed to classify preliminary_outcome eligible, handoff or blocked. Eligible means one bounded executable test-code outcome; production-code change, unknown repository, cross-repository work or unresolved testability architecture requires handoff. Autonomous mode skips human waits only and never grants VCS authority.
nodes.completionCondition: The existing task, mode and authority are preserved and preliminary Lite eligibility is truthfully classified without mutation or numeric heuristics

nodes.directive: Verify workspace correlation. Inspect repository instructions, actual target behavior and public surface, existing tests, fixtures, helpers, framework/configuration, commands, coverage conventions, dependencies and VCS state. Write immutable test-contract.md and concise plan.md with behavioral/risk/boundary cases, intended test levels, authorized files and observable acceptance. Return eligible, handoff when production code or full SDF is required, or blocked. Do not mutate the repository.
nodes.completionCondition: Canonical task and proportionate plan are durable and actual project evidence either confirms Lite eligibility or truthfully produces handoff or blocked

nodes.directive: Delegate a genuinely independent review and keep the same reviewer context for rereview where supported. The reviewer reads the originating task and authority, test-contract.md, plan.md and relevant repository primary sources directly, then overwrites plan-review.md with every current reproducible blocker. It judges task coverage, Lite eligibility, acceptance/evidence modality, dependencies, risks, authority and whether the plan leaves implementation work to an intelligent producer. It does not repair, run linters as semantic judgment, require a finding or design process machinery. Return design_review_outcome=pass only at zero blockers; repair only when every blocker is plan-owned under a valid upstream contract; replan for task interpretation, eligibility, criterion, evidence, authority, process or mixed cause. Return blocked when a genuinely independent review cannot be obtained because of an irreducible capability or authority constraint; do not substitute self-review and call it independent. If the same root returns after one repair without changed relevant source knowledge, return replan. Read accepted corrected-contract.md as part of the effective contract when present.
nodes.completionCondition: For pass, repair or replan, the complete independent plan review is durable and matches the earliest cause; for blocked, a factual durable inability record exists and no independent-review claim is made

nodes.directive: Read plan-review.md, immutable test-contract.md, accepted corrected-contract.md when present, plan.md and relevant repository sources. Reproduce every current plan/design-owned blocker under the complete effective contract. If all are reproducible and upstream authority remains valid, change only derived plan.md coherently without embedding implementation or weakening acceptance, and record root class plus changed relevant knowledge in repair-account.md. Return changed. Return reassess without plan mutation for unreproduced, upstream, evidence-model, mixed, proof-only or same-root-without-stronger-knowledge causes. Do not rewrite test-contract.md or mutate repository files.
nodes.completionCondition: Plan-owned defects are materially repaired for the same independent review or the exact cause is sent to contract reassessment

nodes.directive: Reassess the active process or review cause against immutable test-contract.md, original repository scope, production-code prohibition and commit/push authority. Read corrected-contract-findings.md when the cause came from correction review. Rewrite corrected-contract.md as the complete cumulative supplement, preserving every still-valid correction and recording explicit supersession. Never alter originating authority. Return corrected with earliest reentry_owner target|design|tests|evidence|completion, handoff when production code/full SDF is required, or blocked.
nodes.completionCondition: The earliest invalid contract is materially corrected for plan rereview, or Lite truthfully ends in handoff or blocked without an unchanged loop

nodes.directive: Implement the complete accepted test plan in real authorized project paths. Change only test files and necessary test fixtures/configuration/coverage records; reuse project helpers and public surfaces. Never edit production code or build proof-only mutation machinery. Record exact diff and direct evidence in implementation-evidence.md. Return ready, handoff if production/testability code must change, or blocked. Do not run VCS or external effects. Every repository mutation remains test-side only; if feedback or evidence requires production/testability implementation, stop before mutation and return handoff. Read accepted corrected-contract.md as part of the effective contract when present.
nodes.completionCondition: The complete bounded product result and direct evidence are durable, or spreading/blocked work is truthfully classified without false completion

nodes.directive: Before gates, perform a fresh producer completion pass over immutable test-contract.md, accepted corrected-contract.md when present, accepted plan, actual repository diff, target behavior, tests, fixtures/configuration and evidence. Close ordinary test-side omissions and refresh implementation-evidence.md. It may change only authorized tests, test fixtures/configuration and coverage records. Return ready when complete, handoff only when production/testability implementation is required, replan for an invalid contract/evidence model including any proof-only or non-discriminating evidence request, or blocked for an irreducible prerequisite.
nodes.completionCondition: A fresh whole-diff pass closes ordinary omissions and produces producer-ready bytes, or truthfully routes handoff, contract reassessment or blocked

nodes.directive: Run applicable targeted tests and broader project gates on producer-complete bytes in cost order. Record exact commands, outcomes, applicability and infrastructure limits in validation-evidence.md. Return pass; test_repair for a reproduced test/fixture/config defect; verification_repair for command/evidence-only defects; handoff when production code must change; replan for invalid criterion/plan/process or mixed cause; blocked for an irreducible prerequisite. Do not modify production code or create proof-only harnesses. Read accepted corrected-contract.md as part of the effective contract when present.
nodes.completionCondition: Applicable checks and direct evidence are current and every non-pass result is classified to its earliest owner without surrogate proof

nodes.directive: Read the exact current validation or semantic report, test-contract.md, accepted corrected-contract.md, actual tests and target public behavior. Reproduce every test-owned blocker and repair only authorized tests, fixtures/configuration or coverage records. Never modify production code or create a proof-only proxy, guard, adapter, metatest or mutation harness. Return changed for producer completion, reassess for invalid/mixed/unreproduced causes, or blocked; production/testability changes require reassess for SDF handoff. Read accepted corrected-contract.md as part of the effective contract when present.
nodes.completionCondition: Confirmed test-side defects change for producer completion, while production or non-local causes do not mutate here

nodes.directive: Read the exact current validation or semantic report and reproduce evidence/command-owned defects. Change only command evidence or contained validation artifacts without changing tests, fixtures, configuration, target analysis or case design; return changed to the deterministic gate. If stronger evidence exposes a test-code defect, return test_required with changed knowledge; if it exposes a production defect, return reassess for handoff classification. Do not build proof-only machinery. Read accepted corrected-contract.md as part of the effective contract when present.
nodes.completionCondition: Contained evidence defects are changed, newly exposed product defects return to product ownership, and invalid or irreducible causes do not loop unchanged

nodes.directive: Delegate one genuinely independent whole-result review. Read original authority, test-contract.md, accepted plan, actual diff, target behavior, tests, fixtures/configuration, implementation and validation evidence. Judge realistic failure sensitivity from a reproduced regression or existing authorized mutation facility when available, otherwise from target behavior, assertion path and concrete plausible wrong state. Absence of mutation tooling is not a defect. Overwrite semantic-review.md. Return pass only at zero blockers; repair with owner tests or verification; replan for production/upstream/mixed/criterion causes; blocked when independence is unavailable. Read accepted corrected-contract.md as part of the effective contract when present.
nodes.completionCondition: For pass, repair or replan, the complete independent whole-result review is durable and matches the earliest cause and repair ownership; for blocked, a factual durable inability record exists and no semantic-review claim is made

nodes.directive: Present the independently accepted current result and validation evidence without treating preference as semantic proof. Ask the user to accept, request rework with nonblank feedback, or abort. Acceptance does not expand VCS or external authority. Rework that changes task, eligibility, criterion or evidence model belongs to contract reassessment; bounded product rework returns through producer completion and every stale gate.
nodes.completionCondition: The user accepts the reviewed result, provides actionable rework feedback, or explicitly aborts

nodes.directive: Read {{present-result.feedback}}, immutable test-contract.md, accepted corrected-contract.md, plan.md, semantic-review.md and the actual accepted tests. Reproduce the requested reach. Return tests_changed only after bounded authorized test-side feedback and update implementation-evidence.md. Return reassess for task/criterion/evidence changes, including any proof-only or non-discriminating evidence request. Return handoff only when feedback requires production/testability implementation; never mutate production code. Return blocked for an irreducible test-side prerequisite.
nodes.completionCondition: Feedback is implemented at its real owner or truthfully routes contract reassessment, handoff or blocked

nodes.directive: Close only independently accepted test bytes. commit_authorized={{commit_authorized}} and push_authorized={{push_authorized}} come only from the originating request. Run repository-required pre-commit checks. Commit only when authorized under project authorship/sign-off policy; push only when separately authorized and a valid accepted commit exists. Otherwise skip each effect without asking in autonomous mode. Record independent commit_status and push_status plus factual failures in final-report.md. VCS failure must not be reported as successful generation or product handoff. Never open PR, publish, notify, release or deploy. Read accepted corrected-contract.md as part of the effective contract when present.
nodes.completionCondition: Accepted bytes are truthfully closed under originating VCS authority and final-report.md records the complete local result without broader side effects

nodes.directive: Write or complete {{workspace_path}}/handoff.md as the truthful full-SDF handoff. Preserve the original task and authority, inspected repository evidence, completed safe work, current dirty/commit state, unresolved obligations and risks, and the exact eligibility reason. Do not start full SDF, mutate production code, commit, push, publish, deploy or describe Lite as complete. Return delivery_status=handoff, artifact_path exactly {{workspace_path}}/handoff.md, bounded summary and vcs_status=not_applicable.
nodes.completionCondition: A complete durable full-SDF handoff is projected without false Lite completion or external mutation

nodes.directive: Write {{workspace_path}}/final-report.md with the factual irreducible blocker, completed safe work, repository/VCS state, preserved artifacts and what change in authority, evidence or prerequisites could resume the task. Do not claim semantic acceptance or Lite completion and do not perform external side effects. Return delivery_status=blocked, artifact_path exactly {{workspace_path}}/final-report.md, bounded summary and truthful vcs_status.
nodes.completionCondition: The post-materialization blocker and preserved local state are durable and truthfully projected

nodes.directive: Report the observed materialization failure and recovery action without claiming a workspace artifact or VCS effect. Return delivery_status=materialization_failed and vcs_status=not_applicable.
nodes.completionCondition: The pre-workspace blocker is truthfully projected without a fake artifact path

nodes.directive: Honor the explicit user abort without additional product or VCS mutation. Write {{workspace_path}}/final-report.md with where the run stopped, current safe repository state and existing local artifacts. Return delivery_status=aborted, artifact_path exactly {{workspace_path}}/final-report.md, bounded summary and vcs_status=not_applicable. Do not describe the result as complete or reviewed.
nodes.completionCondition: The explicit abort and current local state are durably and truthfully projected

nodes.hint: Use only when the derived target/test process contract is invalid or incomplete. Never use it for an ordinary test defect, failed command, semantic finding, inconvenience, or authority change; preserve originating repository and VCS authority.
nodes.directive: Use only when the derived target/test process contract itself is invalid or incomplete, never merely because a test command, implementation or review failed. Record the bounded cause and preserved immutable goal, repository scope, production-code prohibition, VCS authority and completed valid work in repair-account.md. Do not bypass ordinary owners or mutate code; reassess-contract performs cumulative correction and typed re-entry.
nodes.completionCondition: A legitimate changed process cause and its invalidation reach are durable for normal contract reassessment

nodes.directive: Delegate independent review of corrected-contract.md against immutable test-contract.md, repository scope, production-code prohibition, VCS authority, prior accepted corrections and actual proposed reentry_owner {{reentry_owner}}. Overwrite corrected-contract-findings.md with all current blockers or zero findings. Return pass only when both cumulative correction and route-driving owner are coherent; return replan or blocked otherwise; do not repair.
nodes.completionCondition: The cumulative correction and earliest re-entry are independently accepted

nodes.directive: Read immutable test-contract.md plus accepted corrected-contract.md and current repository primary sources. Reanalyze only derived target behavior, public surface, existing test patterns and case/design consequences made stale by the accepted correction. Update plan.md and implementation-evidence.md as analysis evidence without rewriting test-contract.md or mutating repository files. Return ready or blocked.
nodes.completionCondition: Derived target/design material reflects the accepted correction while the originating contract remains immutable

workspace_path.description: Execution-correlated materialized workspace for canonical Lite artifacts.

workspace_process_id_file.description: Registry-backed process-id.txt content for workspace correlation.

operating_mode.description: How Lite handles human waits; quality and authority gates are unchanged.

commit_authorized.description: Whether the originating task already authorizes a local Git commit.

task_summary.description: Bounded routing summary of the originating test-generation task.

delivery_status.description: Truthful terminal class for the Lite execution.

artifact_path.description: Validated final-report or handoff artifact beneath the current materialized workspace.

vcs_status.description: Legacy aggregate VCS status for non-complete terminal compatibility.

push_authorized.description: Whether the originating user explicitly authorizes pushing the accepted test commit.

reentry_owner.description: Earliest normal responsibility made stale by accepted contract correction.
